caption: The drawing depicts a single left-hand glove, oriented with the fingers extending to the right and the thumb pointing upward. The glove is depicted in a yellowish-tan color, with subtle shading to indicate form and texture. On the cuff, which is slightly flared and scalloped, there is an ornamental band consisting of floral and circular motifs. The glove has three decorative raised seams running lengthwise from the knuckles to the wrist. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
title: Metal Weather Vane: Glove
